title: Bosstimized
description: A performance-focused modpack designed for low-end and mid-range PCs, improving FPS, reducing lag, and enhancing overall gameplay stability.
body:
# Boostimized

🎯 Boost your Minecraft performance with Boostimized. This lightweight optimization modpack is built around the Vulkan renderer, replacing traditional OpenGL rendering to deliver higher FPS, smoother gameplay, reduced stuttering, and better hardware utilization.

🎯 Unlike content-heavy modpacks, Boostimized focuses entirely on performance, responsiveness, and stability. It combines Vulkan-based rendering with carefully selected optimization mods to reduce CPU overhead, improve chunk loading, optimize memory usage, and provide a more consistent gaming experience.

 # 🔥  Features of Bosstimized Modpack

✅ Uses Vulkan Renderer – Optimized graphics engine for better FPS and lower lag.

✅ Reduces Stuttering & Input Lag – Enjoy a responsive and fluid gaming experience.

✅ Perfect for Low-End PCs – Get more performance even on weak hardware.

✅ Fixes Game Crashes – Vulkan helps reduce memory leaks and crashes.

✅ Improves Modded Performance – Run heavy modpacks without FPS drops.



### Why Boostimized?

Boostimized is designed for players who want the best possible Minecraft performance without unnecessary extras. Every included mod serves a purpose: improving speed, stability, and responsiveness while keeping the vanilla gameplay experience intact.

Whether you're exploring large worlds, playing competitive PvP, or simply looking for a smoother Minecraft experience, Boostimized helps your hardware perform at its full potential.
